proposals.title: Oakland-specific authored identity
proposals.question: Approve, modify, contextualize or reject the exact proposed rule and scope?
proposals.proposed_wording: SkyyRose is authentically rooted in its Oakland origin, founder authorship and lived history. Future work must not fictionalize, erase, contradict or replace that origin.
proposals.consequence: No requirement to depict Oakland in every campaign.

proposals.title: Collections as autobiography
proposals.question: Approve, modify, contextualize or reject the exact proposed rule and scope?
proposals.proposed_wording: Major SkyyRose collections function as authored chapters of lived experience, memory, relationship or legacy. Their meaning must not be replaced with generic trend language without deliberate owner direction.
proposals.consequence: Individual product ads need not explain founder biography.

proposals.title: Gender-neutral presentation
proposals.question: Approve, modify, contextualize or reject the exact proposed rule and scope?
proposals.proposed_wording: SkyyRose presents its core fashion identity without unsupported gender segmentation while preserving exact canonical product facts and fit information.
proposals.consequence: Does not rename products or suppress factual fit details.

proposals.title: Family and legacy
proposals.question: Approve, modify, contextualize or reject the exact proposed rule and scope?
proposals.proposed_wording: SkyyRose preserves its authentic founder-and-family origin; legacy may inform storytelling without requiring family imagery in every campaign.
proposals.consequence: Owner may select L1, L2, L3 or a combination.

proposals.title: Specificity
proposals.question: Approve, modify, contextualize or reject the exact proposed rule and scope?
proposals.proposed_wording: Creative and copy derive character from actual story, product, place, material or meaning rather than generic prestige language.
proposals.consequence: Do not invent details to make copy distinctive.

proposals.title: Intentional narrative
proposals.question: Approve, modify, contextualize or reject the exact proposed rule and scope?
proposals.proposed_wording: Where narrative is used, story, atmosphere and product operate as deliberate beats rather than unrelated decoration.
proposals.consequence: Not every service label or product detail needs a story sequence.

proposals.title: Environmental identity
proposals.question: Approve, modify, contextualize or reject the exact proposed rule and scope?
proposals.proposed_wording: Collection identity may become an environment through marks, materials, light, place, symbols and narrative focal points.
proposals.consequence: No required room, monument or 3D method.

proposals.title: Story-to-product continuation
proposals.question: Approve, modify, contextualize or reject the exact proposed rule and scope?
proposals.proposed_wording: A symbolic or editorial world may introduce a collection and lead to product, on-body or transactional continuation. Storytelling and commerce truth stay separate but connected.
proposals.consequence: Does not prescribe one layout or force every ad through every stage.

proposals.title: Product-connected immersion
proposals.question: Approve, modify, contextualize or reject the exact proposed rule and scope?
proposals.proposed_wording: Immersive experiences connect meaningfully to product discovery. Three-dimensional rendering is one implementation, not a universal requirement.
proposals.consequence: Still imagery, film and other formats remain possible.

proposals.title: Legibility and usable routes
proposals.question: Approve, modify, contextualize or reject the exact proposed rule and scope?
proposals.proposed_wording: Creative ambition retains clear navigation, recognizable product identity and accessible ways to proceed.
proposals.consequence: Basic access must not depend on one effect or device capability.

proposals.title: Cinematic behavior
proposals.question: Approve, modify, contextualize or reject the exact proposed rule and scope?
proposals.proposed_wording: Cinematic expression uses intentional composition, narrative progression, controlled reveal, place as story or connected product discovery where the medium benefits. It does not require dark grading, grain or constant camera movement.
proposals.consequence: Applicable techniques, not a checklist every asset must satisfy.

proposals.title: Role-based hierarchy
proposals.question: Approve, modify, contextualize or reject the exact proposed rule and scope?
proposals.proposed_wording: Visual hierarchy separates identity marks, display emphasis, readable body content and functional information; their treatment serves the medium and context.
proposals.consequence: Exact fonts, sizes and components remain current implementation.

proposals.title: Non-invariants
proposals.question: Approve, modify, contextualize or reject the exact proposed rule and scope?
proposals.proposed_wording: Current devices and implementation choices are not L1 merely because they recur. Elevation requires an explicit owner decision identifying the device and scope.
proposals.consequence: Optional does not mean banned; identify any desired elevation explicitly.

proposals.title: Freedom by domain
proposals.question: Approve, modify, contextualize or reject the exact proposed rule and scope?
proposals.proposed_wording: Constrain factual truth and protected assets while allowing substantial variation in expression within ratified identity, context and intended-use boundaries.
proposals.consequence: High environmental freedom cannot override zero freedom over product truth.

proposals.title: Freedom by mode
proposals.question: Approve, modify, contextualize or reject the exact proposed rule and scope?
proposals.proposed_wording: Exploration modes permit wider proposals; production and release resolve applicable truth, scope and use requirements. Job mode never authorizes false factual claims or changes to depicted real SKUs.
proposals.consequence: Concepts may expose unknowns; they cannot silently become approved output.

proposals.title: Kids boundary
proposals.question: Approve, modify, contextualize or reject the exact proposed rule and scope?
proposals.proposed_wording: Heir/next-generation meaning is Kids context; the throne is one expression, not a required future device.
proposals.consequence: Proposed choice B; owner chooses A throne required, B heir with optional throne, or C neither permanent without brief.

proposals.title: Palette scope
proposals.question: Approve, modify, contextualize or reject the exact proposed rule and scope?
proposals.proposed_wording: Resolve palette restrictions independently for product, master brand, collection, interface, environment and natural photographic color. Permission in one scope does not recolor garments or protected marks.
proposals.consequence: Nonproduct scope changes require approval of exact table; existing restrictions are not silently relaxed.

proposals.title: Saturation and novelty
proposals.question: Approve, modify, contextualize or reject the exact proposed rule and scope?
proposals.proposed_wording: Repetition can create recognition, but devices do not become mandatory because they dominate recent work. Similarity to past creative is not a universal brand-correctness gate.
proposals.consequence: Use explicit statuses; device rotation never distorts protected marks.

freedom_by_domain.domain: Product facts, prices, availability, factual/legal/rights claims, protected asset geometry
freedom_by_domain.limit: No creative override; legitimate source authorities may update facts.
Within applicable voice, mark and current design-system rules.
Preserve legibility, control and usable routes.

freedom_by_domain.domain: Composition, lighting, environment, story and metaphor
freedom_by_domain.limit: Subject to product locks, palette/context scope and intended use.

freedom_by_domain.domain: New concepts and channels at proposal stage
freedom_by_domain.limit: Proposals only; no implicit spend, release or publication authority.

freedom_by_mode.policy: OPEN inquiry; distinguish evidence from speculation.
OPEN proposals. A changed real garment must be a separately labeled unapproved design proposal, never current SKU truth.
HIGH expression within selected direction; unresolved choices/approvals remain visible.
Ratified domain limits and approved brief; missing required truth/use scope blocks dependent work.
Ratified domain limits; no unresolved required truth/scope and separate release authority.
Ratified limits plus current offer/claim/use evidence; separate spending authorization.
NONE for product facts; controlled presentation preserves exact SKU/view/artwork/fit and live purchase-state resolution.

palette.proposed_boundary: Exact current SKU truth; never creatively recolor.
Current authoritative mark/palette variants; changes require explicit owner decision.
Collection identity palette; deviations need a scoped campaign brief or exception.
Permit functional/accessibility colors without redefining brand, collection or product colors.
Allow wider art-directed hues compatible with collection meaning; no automatic universal no-blue rule for environments.
Allow truthful sky/location/material hues; no implied garment or protected-mark recoloring.

statuses.REQUIRED: Identity depends on it in specified scope.

saturation.rule: Frequency or similarity alone cannot assign REQUIRED or RETIRED. Existing retirements remain. Assign device statuses explicitly by scope; no blanket retirement of current scenes.
